newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states favour a joint Arab decision on the Middle East peace process.
- Palestinian President Arafat accuses Israeli government of seeking a Palestinian civil war.
- Al-Rajhi Banking and Investment Corp of Saudi Arabia offers a fund to invest in Egyptian stocks, collects $20 million in less than a month.
- Saudi electricity minister says the power sector in the kingdom needs $112 billion investment until the year 2022.
- Saudi's al-Jouf company gets approval to set up a sugar plant.
- Eight new ministers in new United Arab Emirates government.
- Jerusalem Committee meets on Thursday to discuss how to respond to Israeli plans to build a new settlement.
